uncertainty_areas: Whether .omc/governance-lanes/INDEX.md is considered an authoritative listing that must mirror docs/governance-lanes/INDEX.md, or whether one is an .omc-private mirror that is allowed to lag. The repo carries both as parallel md INDEX files containing identical schema, which suggests they should remain symmetric; if there is an explicit canonical-vs-mirror policy in docs/standards/ I could not locate it within the time budget.
Whether ADR-0119 (specs flat-root, commit 743a6fe6) should have been bundled into PR #13 or kept separate — both are simultaneous structure shifts touching the same files.

Whether `tools/oya-governance-archive-orphan` (without -app suffix) still appearing in ADR-0107 (annotated as `retired by ADR-0118`) is the right place to keep that historical path-shape row vs. removing the row entirely.

findings.summary: Split-state INDEX drift: .omc/governance-lanes/INDEX.md on origin/dev still lists archive-orphan as active (`new-directive` / BLOCKER / `cargo run -p oya-governance-archive-orphan` / 1200ms) while the parallel docs/governance-lanes/INDEX.md was correctly retired by this PR. The .omc INDEX row points at a workspace package and runner path that no longer exist post-merge, breaking the structure-adherence invariant that canonical lane registries stay synchronized.
findings.recommended_action: Follow-up PR: update .omc/governance-lanes/INDEX.md row to match docs/governance-lanes/INDEX.md retirement row (`| archive-orphan | retired | ADR-0118 / ADR-0116 / M01-P18 replacement | retired | retired | retired; no CI invocation | 0 | retired |`) plus append the same dated retirement note row. Optionally add a fitness-lane-registry consistency check (parallel-md-sync) to prevent future drift.

findings.summary: ADR-0107 still contains the literal path `tools/oya-governance-archive-orphan` in its pre-rename inventory block (annotated `# retired by ADR-0118`). The annotation is correct, but mixing retired-historical rows with current-state rename rows in the same code block reduces clarity for downstream BNF-conformance scans.
findings.recommended_action: When ADR-0107 is next touched, move the retired row out of the active inventory block into a dedicated `retired-by-ADR-0118` historical subsection so the active block reflects only live BNF entries.
